arxiv.summary: Background: Much of the enthusiasm for vibe coding rests on two intuitive beliefs: (1) that developers stay invested even when they no longer write the code, and (2) that delegating more of the work to AI lowers their cognitive load. Intercultural Human-Centered AI for Automotive Systems: Bridging ASPICE Processes and Intelligent Human Systems Integration
semantic_scholar.summary: The integration of Artificial Intelligence into safety-critical automotive systems demands approaches that combine technical rigor with cultural and human-centred sensitivity. While Automotive SPICE (ASPICE) ensures structured engineering practices, it lacks explicit guidance on integrating intercultural human factors and intelligent AI-driven support. This paper proposes a framework for Intercultural Human-Centred AI that bridges ASPICE-based practices with intelligent human systems integration
